bot.group_help: This group is the buildwith.uz support inbox. Reply to a person's message and your answer goes to them (👍 means delivered). Messages that aren't replies stay in this group.
bot.help:
Write here — your message goes to the buildwith.uz team and the answer comes back to this chat.

/start — connect notifications
/stop — disconnect Telegram
bot.start_linked:
Done! buildwith.uz notifications will arrive here.

Got a question, an idea or a problem? Write here and the team will answer in this chat.

/stop — disconnect Telegram
bot.start_unknown:
Hi! This is the buildwith.uz support bot.

Got a question, an idea or a problem? Write here and the team will answer in this chat. Photos and files work too.

To get notifications here, sign in to the site with Telegram, then send /start again.
bot.stopped: Telegram is disconnected and your chat id is deleted. Send /start to connect again.
bot.support_header: 📩 From {who}. Reply to this message or the next one to answer.
bot.support_off: Support isn't connected yet. Please write in GitHub Discussions: github.com/buildwithuz/buildwith/discussions
bot.support_slow: That's a lot of messages at once. Please wait a little and write again.
bot.support_undelivered: ⚠️ The reply wasn't delivered: the person may have blocked the bot.
